create.name: Maura Cunningham
create.bio:
Maura Cunningham is an American energy healer, intuitive reader and medium who has worked for more than twenty-five years under the name Pravaha Energy Healing & Insight. Pravaha is a Sanskrit word for a current or stream, and her work rests on the idea that a person's life energy should move freely; when it is blocked, she aims to help it flow again. Her sessions bring together channelled energy work, Reiki, spiritual guidance and shamanic practice, and she describes herself as a neutral channel for that energy rather than as someone who steers it.

Alongside the energy work she offers what she calls insight: impressions, images and messages she picks up intuitively, which she shares at the end of a session to give the client a fresh angle on their life. She also teaches a four-week class in intuitive and spiritual development covering meditation with guides and higher consciousness, the psychic senses, mediumship, automatic writing and the ethics of working with spirit, with more advanced levels to follow. She works with individuals over Zoom and with larger groups in person, and shares free guided meditations recorded over crystal-bowl sound on her site and on Insight Timer.
